title: 16S rRNA Sequencing Data of Fecal Microbiota in an Italian Cohort of Patients with CDKL5 Deficiency Disorder
author: Tognini, Paola
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract bacterial DNA
steps.instruction: Extract bacterial DNA from each fecal sample using the QIAmp PowerFecal DNA Kit (Qiagen, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare 16S library
steps.instruction: Prepare targeted 16S rRNA sequencing libraries with the Quick-16S™ NGS Library Prep Kit (Zymo Research) using the Quick-16S™ Primer Set V3‑V4 (Zymo Research).

substeps.instruction: Set up PCR reactions in a real‑time PCR machine, controlling the number of cycles to limit PCR chimera formation.
Quantify the final PCR products with qPCR fluorescence readings.
Pool the quantified PCR products together at equal molarity.

steps.title: Clean pooled library
steps.instruction: Clean the pooled library using the Select‑a‑Size DNA Clean & Concentrator™ kit.

steps.title: Quantify cleaned library
steps.instruction: Quantify the cleaned library with both a TapeStation® (Agilent Technologies) and a Qubit® fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Sequence library on MiSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the final library on an Illumina® MiSeq™ instrument using a v3 reagent kit (600 cycles).
